definitions.api_elapsed_s: GitHub job.completed_at minus job.started_at; includes setup, tests, artifacts and post steps. Active jobs show elapsed so far.
definitions.observed_step_span_s: Earliest actual setup-step start to latest observed step end, separately retained in case API started_at is a queue placeholder.
definitions.queue_s: API job.started_at minus job.created_at; queued placeholders ignored. In a queued row this is a lower bound so far.
definitions.ready_to_complete_s: Completed job.completed_at minus job.created_at: queue plus complete execution.
definitions.dependency_wait_s: Job.created_at minus workflow.created_at; includes admission and upstream needs waits.
definitions.completed_after_gate_s: Job completion minus completed gate timestamp. Family maxima include runner queues and all execution.
definitions.vector_order: Ascending shard coordinate; suites_evidence is a separate one-job family.
definitions.ten_minute_test: Every one of23 execution jobs must succeed with full API elapsed strictly below600s; this does not claim total workflow or family end-to-end below600s.
